unanswered.author: alicia thomas
unanswered.snippet: Husband's 70th Birthday. Just came to chill and try the beer and food. Everything was off the chain great. We had Fish and Chips, seasoned fries cooked to perfection! The fish was meaty. Pulled Pork Tacos (2) BBQ style was amazing! Housemade Gorgonzola Potato Chips with a flight of beers (Red Cent, Imperial Red IPA, Casey's Black IPA, Motivation Destroyer IPA).
unanswered.draftReply: Alicia, what a joy it was to help celebrate your husband's 70th! So glad the fish and chips and BBQ pulled pork tacos hit the spot, and that beer flight (Red Cent, Imperial Red IPA, Casey's Black IPA, Motivation Destroyer) sounds like the perfect lineup. Happy belated birthday to him -- we can't wait to see you both again!

unanswered.author: William
unanswered.draftReply: Thanks, William! Glad the burgers and beer selection hit the mark -- come back soon and we'll get you trying a few more on tap.

unanswered.author: Seanit Rover
unanswered.snippet: They don't allow the American flag. I thought we were all Americans under one flag. Both Democrats and Republicans have served and died for our country and flag. I will NEVER come back!
unanswered.draftReply: Seanit, thank you for sharing this -- we're sorry your visit left you feeling this way, that's not the experience we want for any guest. We'd welcome the chance to talk it through directly; please reach out to us at the restaurant anytime. We hope you'll consider giving us another chance.
unanswered.flag: Sensitive/political complaint -- reply kept neutral and non-political per standing policy. Recommend Joal review personally before posting.

unanswered.author: John Rinaldo
unanswered.draftReply: John, thanks for taking the time to rate us. We're sorry this visit didn't meet the mark -- we'd genuinely like to know more so we can make it right. Please reach out to us directly at the restaurant when you have a moment.

unanswered.author: Matthew Lourie
unanswered.draftReply: Matthew, thanks so much for the 5 stars and for stopping by The Brewhouse! Appreciate you sharing photos with fellow Local Guides -- hope to see you back again soon.
